headline: Late-session WATCH amid broad rebound and extreme cross-asset Stress
body: Friday equities are broadly higher, but technology leadership is mixed and the available evidence does not show a persistent no-retracement Nasdaq path. Elevated long Treasury yields and severe Strait of Hormuz disruption keep Stress extreme. The current power hour is a narrow continuation checkpoint.
